flags.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹2,036 cr, −2% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹18.0 cr, −49% on the prior twelve months.
Revenue has compounded at 24% over 10 years, 32% over 5 and 19% over 3; the last twelve months (−2%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (194% vs 19%): operating leverage is working.
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: −24% → −24% → −14% → +53% YoY.
Operating margin has expanded to 11.1% from -31.2% a year ago (+42.3 pp).
Annual operating margin has ranged from −2% to 14% over five years; the latest year (−2%) sits at the bottom of that range.
Borrowings are ₹220 cr against equity of ₹3,832 cr: debt/equity 0.06× (was 0.03× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 13.7× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 75 days from 51 in Mar 2023 (debtor days 51 → 75): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 32.0%, −3.5 pp over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 15.4%, +3.4 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹376 cr of operating cash came from ₹374 cr of operating profit: 101% conversion; against PAT of ₹320 cr that is 1.2×.
Other income is 4200% of pre-tax profit over the last twelve months — earnings lean on non-operating items.

business.what: Nazara Technologies operates as a diversified digital gaming and sports media company. It makes money through in-app purchases, advertising, subscriptions, premium game title sales, entry ticketing, and esports media rights.

annual_report.what: Nazara Technologies operates as a diversified digital gaming and sports media company. It makes money through in-app purchases, advertising, subscriptions, premium game title sales, entry ticketing, and esports media rights.

guidance.label: NODWIN organic growth target
guidance.statement: NODWIN is targeting organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards its IPO readiness.
guidance.quote: NODWIN is targeting organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards its IPO readiness.
guidance.speaker: Anupriya Sinha Das

verdict.detail: Guidance for NODWIN, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Accelerate growth in revenues in FY27
guidance.statement: We will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27.
guidance.quote: we will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27.
guidance.speaker: Nitish Mittersain

verdict.detail: A direction for growth (e.g. 'outgrow the market') has no benchmark in the company's own numbers; kept as a watch item.

guidance.label: Accelerate growth in EBITDA in FY27
guidance.statement: We will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27.
guidance.quote: we will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27.
guidance.speaker: Nitish Mittersain

verdict.detail: An absolute EBITDA target needs a rupee figure; none was given.

claims.claim: Q2 was a record quarter for us: Revenue was INR 803 crores, our highest ever, up 53% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Q2 was a record quarter for us: Revenue was INR 803 crores, our highest ever, up 53% year-on-year.

claims.claim: EBITDA grew 93% to INR 120 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 311 basis points to 14.9%.
claims.quote: EBITDA grew 93% to INR 120 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 311 basis points to 14.9%.

claims.claim: Profit After Tax from continuing operations was INR 35 crores, compared with a loss of INR 34 crores in Q2 FY26.
claims.quote: Profit After Tax from continuing operations was INR 35 crores, compared with a loss of INR 34 crores in Q2 FY26.

claims.claim: In their first two months as part of Nazara, Bluetile and BestPlay generated revenue of INR 329 crores, up 49%.
claims.quote: In their first two months as part of Nazara, Bluetile and BestPlay generated revenue of INR 329 crores, up 49%.

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue came in at INR 429 crores, and EBITDA was INR 46 crores.
claims.quote: Consolidated revenue came in at INR 429 crores, and EBITDA was INR 46 crores.

claims.claim: Excluding the impact of NODWIN's deconsolidation, comparable consolidated revenue grew approximately 9% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Excluding the impact of NODWIN's deconsolidation, comparable consolidated revenue grew approximately 9% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Our gaming revenue increased 14% year-on-year to INR 275 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 19.5%.
claims.quote: Our gaming revenue increased 14% year-on-year to INR 275 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 19.5% and all our gaming businesses remained EBITDA positive while showing positive growth.

claims.claim: Kiddopia revenues grew 19% year-on-year as our user acquisition scaled, behind improving unit economics.
claims.quote: Kiddopia revenues grew 19% year-on-year as our user acquisition scaled, behind improving unit economics.

claims.claim: Fusebox increased 12% year-on-year to INR 82 crores, whereas Animal Jam's revenue also grew 11% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Fusebox, which runs the popular game Love Island, increased 12% year-on-year to INR 82 crores, whereas Animal Jam’s revenue also grew 11% year-on-year.

claims.claim: The Bluetile and BestPlay business reported INR 518 crores of revenue and INR 55 crores of EBITDA in Q1 FY27.
claims.quote: For reference, the Bluetile and BestPlay business reported INR 518 crores of revenue and INR 55 crores of EBITDA in Q1 FY27.

claims.claim: Revenue reached INR 1,829 crores and EBITDA grew 66% to INR 255 crores, our highest ever.
claims.quote: Revenue reached INR 1,829 crores and EBITDA grew 66% to INR 255 crores, our highest ever

claims.claim: Pre-tax operating cash flows grew 81% year-on-year to INR 213 crores in FY26.
claims.quote: pre-tax operating cash flows growing 81% year-on-year to INR 213 crores.

claims.claim: Kiddopia has returned to subscriber growth, seeing growth in Q3 and Q4.
claims.quote: Kiddopia has returned to subscriber growth. We saw growth in Kiddopia in Q3 and now again in Q4.

claims.claim: Human Fall Flat crossed 58 million lifetime units globally.
claims.quote: Human Fall Flat crossed 58 million lifetime units globally.

claims.claim: Kiddopia achieved a much-awaited resumption in subscriber growth in this quarter, driven by management and COE efforts.
claims.quote: Kiddopia achieved a much-awaited resumption in subscriber growth in this quarter, driven by the hard work of the team as well as Nazara's centers of excellence

claims.claim: EBITDA came in at INR67.8 crore, up 29.4%, and margins expanded to 16.7% due to refocus on higher-margin IP-based gaming.
claims.quote: our EBITDA came in at INR67.8 crore, which was up 29.4% during the same period and our margins expanded to 16.7% as the company refocused on its higher-margin IP-based gaming business.

claims.claim: Sportskeeda executed significant cost realignment as Q3 FY26 costs were down 32% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Sportskeeda executed significant cost realignment as Q3 FY26 costs were down 32% year-on-year.

claims.claim: In H1 FY26, revenue grew 80.2% YoY and EBITDA grew 118.5% YoY.
claims.quote: Nazara delivered INR 1025.2 crores in revenue in H1 FY26, up 80.2% year-on-year, and INR 109.4 crores EBITDA, up 118.5% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Operating cash flow for H1 FY26 was INR 71.5 crores on a pre-tax basis, up 170.8% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Our operating cash flow for the first half of this year was INR 71.5 crores on a pre-tax basis, up 170.8% year-on-year

claims.claim: Over 90% of gaming revenue comes from international markets, with a strong focus on the US and UK.
claims.quote: At this point of time, over 90% of our gaming revenue comes from international markets, with a strong focus on the US and the UK markets.

claims.claim: Smaaash and Funky Monkeys delivered INR 12 crores of EBITDA in H1 FY26 at a 27.5% margin.
claims.quote: Turning to offline gaming consisting of Smaaash and Funky Monkeys, the portfolio delivered INR 12 crores of EBITDA in H1 FY26 at a 27.5% margin.

claims.claim: Sportskeeda drove a 13% YoY cost reduction in Q2 and is planning a 40% YoY reduction in Q3.
claims.quote: Management has proactively executed cost measures, driving a 13% year-on-year cost reduction in Q2 and planning a 40% year-on-year reduction in Q3.

claims.claim: Nazara reported Q1 FY26 revenues of ₹498.8 crores, up 99% year-on-year, and EBITDA of ₹47.4 crores, up 90% year-on-year.
claims.quote: In Q1 FY26, Nazara reported revenues of ₹498.8 crores, that was up 99% year-on-year and an EBITDA of 47.4 crores, up 90% year-on-year.
